label: Screened out by effort check
detail: did not reproduce a target sentence exactly, or left rather than do so

label: Screened out by equipment check
detail: could not demonstrate a working camera, microphone, and headphones, or left rather than do so

label:
Voluntarily left, or screened out as non-US,
during the pre-discussion surveys
detail: 27 left of their own accord and 7 were screened out for taking part from outside the US; they stopped during 23 trait ratings, 4 RME, 4 Big-5, 1 demographics, 1 topic pre-survey, 1 feeling thermometers

label:
Voluntarily left during the countdown
to the scheduled start
detail: answered every question, then would not wait out the countdown; median 5 min of scheduled wait remained when they entered it

label:
No cross-partisan partner available
within the matching window
detail: matching required a counter-partisan in the waiting room at the same time whose position on an available topic completed an open condition cell

label: Partner and treatment assigned
detail: 10 topics; every measure above was collected before condition was assigned, and no participant saw their discussion topic until this point. Dispatch assigned complete dyads only, so this count comes from the 1032 preregistration records rather than the 1031 session records

label:
Dropped after assignment,
before reaching the conversation
detail: 1 dropped at dispatch and produced no session data at all; 30 more never had video recorded and never used the in-call reporting tool, so no evidence places them in the call

label:
Excluded because one or both partners
reported problems with the call
detail: reported by one partner in 93 dyads and by both in 15. Everyone still in a failed dyad is excluded with it, including the partners of the participants who never arrived

label: Did not complete the post-discussion survey
